question: How much did we invoice each month in 2025, and what's the running total over the year?
question_template: How much did we invoice each month in 2025, and what's the running total over the year?
answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' of issued_date, invoiced amount that month, running total since January; both rounded to 2 decimals; 2025 only; ordered by month.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(tajj.c04, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(tajj.c13) AS invoiced FROM tajj AS tajj WHERE tajj.c04 >= '2025-01-01' AND tajj.c04 < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(tajj.c04, 1, 7)) SELECT m.month AS month, ROUND(m.invoiced, 2) AS invoiced_usd, ROUND(SUM(m.invoiced) OVER (ORDER BY m.month), 2) AS cumulative_usd FROM m AS m ORDER BY month

question: Which three warehouses have the longest import dwell time from flight arrival to consignee delivery?
question_template: Which three warehouses have the longest import dwell time from flight arrival to consignee delivery?
answer_spec: Columns: warehouse_code, delivered shipments, average hours between the RCF and DLV events of the same shipment at that warehouse (rounded 2); warehouses with at least 20 such shipments; the 3 with the longest average.
gold_sql: SELECT w.c02 AS c02, COUNT(*) AS deliveries, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(d.c07) - JULIANDAY(r.c07)) * 24), 2) AS avg_dwell_hours FROM t3z7 AS r JOIN t3z7 AS d ON d.c02 = r.c02 AND d.c06 = 'DLV' JOIN trhn AS w ON w.c01 = r.c05 WHERE r.c06 = 'RCF' GROUP BY w.c01, w.c02 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_dwell_hours DESC, c02 LIMIT 3

question: At which 5 airports do shipments wait the longest between being dropped off and flying out?
question_template: At which 5 airports do shipments wait the longest between being dropped off and flying out?
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, average hours between a shipment's RCS scan and its first DEP event (rounded 2); shipments that departed only; the 5 airports with the longest average.
gold_sql: WITH t AS (SELECT t3z7.c02 AS c02, MIN(CASE WHEN t3z7.c06 = 'RCS' THEN t3z7.c07 END) AS rcs, MIN(CASE WHEN t3z7.c06 = 'DEP' THEN t3z7.c07 END) AS dep FROM t3z7 AS t3z7 GROUP BY t3z7.c02) SELECT a.c02 AS c02, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(t.dep) - JULIANDAY(t.rcs)) * 24), 2) AS avg_hours_rcs_to_departure FROM t AS t JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = t.c02 JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = s.c06 WHERE NOT t.rcs IS NULL AND NOT t.dep IS NULL GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 ORDER BY avg_hours_rcs_to_departure DESC, c02 LIMIT 5

question: For each airline, what percentage of completed flights left more than 15 minutes late?
question_template: For each airline, what percentage of completed flights left more than 15 minutes late?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, completed flights, percentage departing more than 15 minutes late (rounded 1); ordered by percentage DESC.
gold_sql: SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN (JULIANDAY(f.c09) - JULIANDAY(f.c07)) * 1440 > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_departure_pct FROM tx7n AS f JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = f.c04 JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = a.c05 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY al.c01, al.c04 ORDER BY late_departure_pct DESC, airline_name

question: At which connecting airports did two-leg shipments sit more than 48 hours between flights?
question_template: At which connecting airports did two-leg shipments sit more than 48 hours between flights?
answer_spec: Columns: connecting airport iata_code, number of two-leg shipments whose ground time there (leg 2 actual departure - leg 1 actual arrival) exceeded 48 hours; both legs flown; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.c02 AS c02, COUNT(*) AS long_connections FROM tg6t AS l1 JOIN tg6t AS l2 ON l2.c02 = l1.c02 AND l2.c04 = 2 JOIN tx7n AS f1 ON f1.c01 = l1.c03 JOIN tx7n AS f2 ON f2.c01 = l2.c03 JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = f1.c06 WHERE l1.c04 = 1 AND f1.c19 = 'completed' AND f2.c19 = 'completed' AND (JULIANDAY(f2.c09) - JULIANDAY(f1.c10)) * 24 > 48 GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 ORDER BY long_connections DESC, c02

question: Which captain and first officer pairs flew together on at least 10 completed flights?
question_template: Which captain and first officer pairs flew together on at least 10 completed flights?

gold_sql: SELECT mc.c02 AS captain, mf.c02 AS first_officer, COUNT(*) AS flights_together FROM tpsn AS c JOIN tpsn AS fo ON fo.c02 = c.c02 AND fo.c04 = 'first_officer' JOIN t6sc AS mc ON mc.c01 = c.c03 JOIN t6sc AS mf ON mf.c01 = fo.c03 WHERE c.c04 = 'captain' AND c.c12 = 'completed' GROUP BY mc.c02, mf.c02 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 ORDER BY flights_together DESC, captain, first_officer

question: Which airports had more completed departures in Q4 2025 than in Q3? Show both numbers.
question_template: Which airports had more completed departures in Q4 2025 than in Q3? Show both numbers.
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, completed departures in Q3 2025 (Jul-Sep, by actual_departure), in Q4 2025 (Oct-Dec); airports where Q4 > Q3; ordered by iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.c02 AS c02, SUM(CASE WHEN f.c09 >= '2025-07-01' AND f.c09 < '2025-10-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q3_departures, SUM(CASE WHEN f.c09 >= '2025-10-01' AND f.c09 < '2026-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q4_departures FROM tx7n AS f JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = f.c05 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 HAVING q4_departures > q3_departures ORDER BY c02

question_template: Which customers still have open invoices but haven't paid anything in the last 60 days, and how many invoices are open?

question: If we split all shipments into four equal groups by weight, how many of the heaviest group belong to each type of goods?

question: Among customers with at least 20 shipments, which 5 book most often, measured by average days between bookings?
question_template: Among customers with at least 20 shipments, which 5 book most often, measured by average days between bookings?

question: Which planes flew more hours than the average plane of their own airline?
question_template: Which planes flew more hours than the average plane of their own airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, tail_number, completed block hours (rounded 1) of aircraft whose completed block hours exceed the average of their airline's flying aircraft; ordered by airline name, hours DESC.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT a.c05 AS c05, a.c02 AS c02, SUM((JULIANDAY(f.c10) - JULIANDAY(f.c09)) * 24) AS hours FROM tx7n AS f JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = f.c04 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY a.c01, a.c05, a.c02), avg_h AS (SELECT h.c05 AS c05, AVG(h.hours) AS avg_hours FROM h AS h GROUP BY h.c05) SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, h.c02 AS c02, ROUND(h.hours, 1) AS block_hours FROM h AS h JOIN avg_h AS avg_h ON avg_h.c05 = h.c05 JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = h.c05 WHERE h.hours > avg_h.avg_hours ORDER BY airline_name, block_hours DESC

question: For each airline, how often did a flight leave over an hour late right after the same plane's previous flight arrived over an hour late?
question_template: For each airline, how often did a flight leave over an hour late right after the same plane's previous flight arrived over an hour late?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, number of completed flights departing more than 60 minutes late whose aircraft's previous completed flight arrived more than 60 minutes late; ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT f.c04 AS c04, (JULIANDAY(f.c09) - JULIANDAY(f.c07)) * 1440 AS dep_delay, LAG((JULIANDAY(f.c10) - JULIANDAY(f.c08)) * 1440) OVER (PARTITION BY f.c04 ORDER BY f.c09) AS prev_arr_delay FROM tx7n AS f WHERE f.c19 = 'completed') SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS knock_on_delays FROM s AS s JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = s.c04 JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = a.c05 WHERE s.dep_delay > 60 AND s.prev_arr_delay > 60 GROUP BY al.c01, al.c04 ORDER BY knock_on_delays DESC, airline_name

gold_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT t875.c04 AS c04, AVG(t875.c12) AS avg_price FROM t875 AS t875 GROUP BY t875.c04) SELECT a.c02 AS c02, ROUND(p.avg_price, 4) AS avg_price_usd_per_litre, ROUND(p.avg_price - (SELECT AVG(t875.c12) AS _col_0 FROM t875 AS t875), 4) AS diff_vs_network FROM p AS p JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = p.c04 ORDER BY p.avg_price DESC, a.c02 LIMIT 5

question: At which airports did export customs clear less than 2 hours before the plane actually left?
question_template: At which airports did export customs clear less than 2 hours before the plane actually left?
answer_spec: Columns: origin iata_code, number of cleared export declarations cleared less than 2 hours before the shipment's leg-1 actual departure; airports with none omitted; ordered by count DESC, iata_code.
gold_sql: SELECT a.c02 AS c02, COUNT(*) AS last_minute_clearances FROM t3v5 AS d JOIN tg6t AS fc ON fc.c02 = d.c03 AND fc.c04 = 1 JOIN tx7n AS f ON f.c01 = fc.c03 JOIN ts53 AS a ON a.c01 = f.c05 WHERE d.c05 = 'export' AND d.c18 = 'cleared' AND f.c19 = 'completed' AND (JULIANDAY(f.c09) - JULIANDAY(d.c17)) * 24 < 2 GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 ORDER BY last_minute_clearances DESC, c02

question: Rank goods types by total declared value and show what share of the total we reach as we add them up.
question_template: Rank goods types by total declared value and show what share of the total we reach as we add them up.
answer_spec: Columns: commodity_category, declared value of its non-cancelled shipments (rounded 2), cumulative share of the total in percent when categories are ordered by value DESC (rounded 2); ordered by value DESC.

question: What did we spend on fuel each month, and what's the three-month moving average?

question_template: Show monthly fuel spend with a rolling three-month average to smooth out the trend.
answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' of uplift_time, fuel cost that month, 3-month moving average (this month and the 2 before; fewer at the start), both rounded to 2; ordered by month.
gold_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(t875.c08, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(t875.c13) AS cost FROM t875 AS t875 GROUP BY SUBSTRING(t875.c08, 1, 7)) SELECT m.month AS month, ROUND(m.cost, 2) AS fuel_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(m.cost) OVER (ORDER BY m.month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_3m_usd FROM m AS m ORDER BY month

question: Which five planes went the longest between two maintenance jobs, and how many days was that?
question_template: Which five planes went the longest between two maintenance jobs, and how many days was that?
answer_spec: Columns: tail_number, longest gap in days between the start_time of two consecutive completed maintenance records of the same aircraft (rounded 1); the 5 aircraft with the longest gap.
gold_sql: WITH g AS (SELECT tcse.c03 AS c03, JULIANDAY(tcse.c08) - JULIANDAY(LAG(tcse.c08) OVER (PARTITION BY tcse.c03 ORDER BY tcse.c08)) AS gap_days FROM tcse AS tcse WHERE tcse.c16 = 'completed') SELECT a.c02 AS c02, ROUND(MAX(g.gap_days), 1) AS longest_gap_days FROM g AS g JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = g.c03 GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 ORDER BY MAX(g.gap_days) DESC LIMIT 5

question: In each airline, which captain has logged the most block hours as captain, and how many?
question_template: In each airline, which captain has logged the most block hours as captain, and how many?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, captain employee_number, credited block hours (SUM(block_minutes_credited)/60 over completed assignments in the 'captain' duty role, rounded 1): per airline the captain with most hours (ties: employee_number); ordered by airline name.
gold_sql: WITH h AS (SELECT m.c06 AS c06, m.c02 AS c02, SUM(ca.c08) AS minutes FROM tpsn AS ca JOIN t6sc AS m ON m.c01 = ca.c03 WHERE ca.c04 = 'captain' AND ca.c12 = 'completed' GROUP BY m.c01, m.c06, m.c02), r AS (SELECT h.c06 AS c06, h.c02 AS c02, h.minutes AS minutes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY h.c06 ORDER BY h.minutes DESC, h.c02) AS rn FROM h AS h) SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, r.c02 AS c02, ROUND(r.minutes / 60.0, 1) AS block_hours FROM r AS r JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = r.c06 WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY airline_name

question: Which customers did we invoice more than 1.5 times as much in the second half of 2025 as in the first half?
question_template: Which customers did we invoice more than 1.5 times as much in the second half of 2025 as in the first half?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, invoiced USD in H1 2025 (issued Jan-Jun), in H2 2025 (Jul-Dec), both rounded 2; customers whose H2 amount is more than 1.5 times the H1 amount; ordered by name.
gold_sql: SELECT c.c03 AS c03, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.c04 < '2025-07-01' THEN i.c13 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h1_usd, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.c04 >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.c13 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS h2_usd FROM tajj AS i JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = i.c03 JOIN th77 AS c ON c.c01 = s.c03 WHERE i.c04 >= '2025-01-01' AND i.c04 < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.c01, c.c03 HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN i.c04 >= '2025-07-01' THEN i.c13 ELSE 0 END) > 1.5 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.c04 < '2025-07-01' THEN i.c13 ELSE 0 END) ORDER BY c03

question: Which five customers owe us the most on invoices that aren't fully paid?
question_template: Which five customers owe us the most on invoices that aren't fully paid?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, open balance in USD = invoice amount minus payments received, summed over its invoices with status 'unpaid' or 'partially_paid' (rounded 2); the 5 customers with the largest open balance.
gold_sql: WITH paid AS (SELECT t8tg.c03 AS c03, SUM(t8tg.c06) AS paid_usd FROM t8tg AS t8tg GROUP BY t8tg.c03) SELECT c.c03 AS c03, ROUND(SUM(i.c13 - COALESCE(p.paid_usd, 0)), 2) AS open_balance_usd FROM tajj AS i LEFT JOIN paid AS p ON p.c03 = i.c01 JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = i.c03 JOIN th77 AS c ON c.c01 = s.c03 WHERE i.c15 IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid') GROUP BY c.c01, c.c03 ORDER BY open_balance_usd DESC LIMIT 5

question: For each airline, how many completed flights did each aircraft model fly, and what share of the airline's flights is that?
question_template: For each airline, how many completed flights did each aircraft model fly, and what share of the airline's flights is that?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, model, completed flights of that airline on that model, share of the airline's completed flights in percent (rounded 1); ordered by airline name, flights DESC.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT a.c05 AS c05, t.c02 AS c02, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM tx7n AS f JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = f.c04 JOIN tumf AS t ON t.c01 = a.c04 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY a.c05, t.c02) SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, c.c02 AS c02, c.flights AS flights, ROUND(100.0 * c.flights / SUM(c.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY c.c05), 1) AS share_pct FROM c AS c JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = c.c05 ORDER BY airline_name, c.flights DESC

question: What's the median chargeable weight of delivered shipments for each service level?
question_template: What's the median chargeable weight of delivered shipments for each service level?
answer_spec: Columns: service_level, median chargeable_weight_kg of its delivered shipments (mean of the two middle values when the count is even, rounded 1); ordered by service_level.
gold_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT t89v.c10 AS c10, t89v.c15 AS c15, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t89v.c10 ORDER BY t89v.c15) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY t89v.c10) AS n FROM t89v AS t89v WHERE t89v.c22 = 'delivered') SELECT o.c10 AS c10, ROUND(AVG(o.c15), 1) AS median_chargeable_kg FROM o AS o WHERE o.rn IN ((o.n + 1) / 2, (o.n + 2) / 2) GROUP BY o.c10 ORDER BY c10

question: After an AOG repair, how many hours does it take before the plane flies again, by airline?
question_template: After an AOG repair, how many hours does it take before the plane flies again, by airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name, AOG maintenance events (completed, is_aog = 1) followed by a completed flight of the same aircraft, average hours from the maintenance end_time to that aircraft's first completed departure after it (rounded 1); ordered by airline name.
gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT a.c05 AS c05, (SELECT MIN(f.c09) AS _col_0 FROM tx7n AS f WHERE f.c04 = m.c03 AND f.c19 = 'completed' AND f.c09 >= m.c09) AS next_departure, m.c09 AS c09 FROM tcse AS m JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = m.c03 WHERE m.c14 = 1 AND m.c16 = 'completed') SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, COUNT(*) AS aog_events, ROUND(AVG((JULIANDAY(r.next_departure) - JULIANDAY(r.c09)) * 24), 1) AS avg_hours_to_next_departure FROM r AS r JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = r.c05 WHERE NOT r.next_departure IS NULL GROUP BY al.c01, al.c04 ORDER BY airline_name

gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT a.c05 AS c05, o.c02 AS origin, d.c02 AS destination, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM tx7n AS f JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = f.c04 JOIN ts53 AS o ON o.c01 = f.c05 JOIN ts53 AS d ON d.c01 = f.c06 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' GROUP BY a.c05, o.c02, d.c02), r AS (SELECT c.c05 AS c05, c.origin AS origin, c.destination AS destination, c.flights AS flights, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c05 ORDER BY c.flights DESC, c.origin, c.destination) AS rn FROM c AS c) SELECT al.c04 AS airline_name, r.origin AS origin, r.destination AS destination, r.flights AS flights FROM r AS r JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = r.c05 WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY airline_name, r.flights DESC, r.origin, r.destination

question: How do our unpaid invoices age as of 20 December 2025: not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days late?
question_template: How do our unpaid invoices age as of 20 December 2025: not due, 1-30, 31-60 and over 60 days late?
answer_spec: Columns: ageing bucket of invoices with status not 'paid' by days past due_date on 2025-12-20 ('not due', '1-30', '31-60', '61+'), number of invoices, SUM(amount_usd) rounded 2; ordered by the bucket order above.
gold_sql: WITH b AS (SELECT tajj.c13 AS c13, CASE WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(tajj.c05) <= 0 THEN 'not due' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(tajj.c05) <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN JULIANDAY('2025-12-20') - JULIANDAY(tajj.c05) <= 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket FROM tajj AS tajj WHERE tajj.c15 <> 'paid') SELECT b.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoices, ROUND(SUM(b.c13), 2) AS amount_usd FROM b AS b GROUP BY b.bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'not due' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.c13 AS c13, cu.c03 AS c03, COUNT(*) AS shipments FROM t89v AS s JOIN th77 AS cu ON cu.c01 = s.c03 WHERE s.c22 <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY cu.c01, cu.c13, cu.c03), r AS (SELECT c.c13 AS c13, c.c03 AS c03, c.shipments AS shipments, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c13 ORDER BY c.shipments DESC) AS region_rank FROM c AS c) SELECT r.c13 AS c13, r.c03 AS c03, r.shipments AS shipments, r.region_rank AS region_rank FROM r AS r WHERE r.region_rank <= 2 ORDER BY c13, region_rank, c03

gold_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT s.c03 AS c03, SUM(i.c13) AS revenue FROM tajj AS i JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = i.c03 GROUP BY s.c03), q AS (SELECT r.c03 AS c03, r.revenue AS revenue, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY r.revenue DESC, r.c03) AS quintile FROM r AS r) SELECT q.quintile AS quintile, COUNT(*) AS customers, ROUND(SUM(q.revenue), 2) AS invoiced_usd, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(q.revenue) / (SELECT SUM(r.revenue) AS _col_0 FROM r AS r), 1) AS share_pct FROM q AS q GROUP BY q.quintile ORDER BY quintile

question: How many flights were cancelled because of weather in each month of 2025, including months with none?
question_template: How many flights were cancelled because of weather in each month of 2025, including months with none?
answer_spec: Columns: every month '2025-01' to '2025-12', number of flights with cancellation_reason 'weather' scheduled that month (0 when none); ordered by month.
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(m) AS (SELECT '2025-01-01' AS m UNION ALL SELECT DATE(months.m, '+1 month') AS m FROM months AS months WHERE months.m < '2025-12-01') SELECT SUBSTRING(months.m, 1, 7) AS month, COUNT(f.c01) AS weather_cancellations FROM months AS months LEFT JOIN tx7n AS f ON SUBSTRING(f.c07, 1, 7) = SUBSTRING(months.m, 1, 7) AND f.c18 = 'weather' GROUP BY months.m ORDER BY month

question: Which planes flew on three or more days in a row, and what's their longest streak?
question_template: Which planes flew on three or more days in a row, and what's their longest streak?
answer_spec: Columns: tail_number, longest run of consecutive calendar days with at least one completed departure (by date of actual_departure); aircraft with a run of at least 3 days; ordered by run DESC, tail_number.
gold_sql: WITH d AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx7n.c04 AS c04, DATE(tx7n.c09) AS day FROM tx7n AS tx7n WHERE tx7n.c19 = 'completed'), g AS (SELECT d.c04 AS c04, d.day AS day, JULIANDAY(d.day) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.c04 ORDER BY d.day) AS grp FROM d AS d), runs AS (SELECT g.c04 AS c04, g.grp AS grp, COUNT(*) AS run_days FROM g AS g GROUP BY g.c04, g.grp) SELECT a.c02 AS c02, MAX(r.run_days) AS longest_run_days FROM runs AS r JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = r.c04 GROUP BY a.c01, a.c02 HAVING MAX(r.run_days) >= 3 ORDER BY longest_run_days DESC, c02

question: Which customers have an average invoice at least 1.5 times the average for their customer type?
question_template: Which customers have an average invoice at least 1.5 times the average for their customer type?
answer_spec: Columns: customer name, customer_type, average invoice amount_usd of the customer, average over the customers of the same type (mean of the customer averages), both rounded 2; customers at least 1.5 times their type average; ordered by customer_type, name.

gold_sql: WITH y AS (SELECT s.c11 AS c11, s.c02 AS c02, s.c01 AS c01, i.c13 / s.c15 AS usd_per_kg FROM tajj AS i JOIN t89v AS s ON s.c01 = i.c03), r AS (SELECT y.c11 AS c11, y.c02 AS c02, y.c01 AS c01, y.usd_per_kg AS usd_per_kg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY y.c11 ORDER BY y.usd_per_kg DESC, y.c01) AS rn FROM y AS y) SELECT r.c11 AS c11, r.c02 AS c02, ROUND(r.usd_per_kg, 2) AS usd_per_chargeable_kg FROM r AS r WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY c11

question: In each month of Q4 2025, what share of completed flights did each airline operate?
question_template: In each month of Q4 2025, what share of completed flights did each airline operate?
answer_spec: Columns: month 'YYYY-MM' (Oct-Dec 2025, by actual_departure), airline name, completed flights, share of that month's completed flights in percent (rounded 1); ordered by month, flights DESC, airline name.
gold_sql: WITH c AS (SELECT SUBSTRING(f.c09, 1, 7) AS month, a.c05 AS c05, COUNT(*) AS flights FROM tx7n AS f JOIN tu5q AS a ON a.c01 = f.c04 WHERE f.c19 = 'completed' AND f.c09 >= '2025-10-01' AND f.c09 < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(f.c09, 1, 7), a.c05) SELECT c.month AS month, al.c04 AS airline_name, c.flights AS flights, ROUND(100.0 * c.flights / SUM(c.flights) OVER (PARTITION BY c.month), 1) AS share_pct FROM c AS c JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = c.c05 ORDER BY c.month, c.flights DESC, airline_name

question: For two-leg shipments, how often does the second leg go on a different airline, by first-leg airline?
question_template: For two-leg shipments, how often does the second leg go on a different airline, by first-leg airline?
answer_spec: Columns: airline name of leg 1, number of two-leg shipments whose leg 2 is flown by a different airline (interline); ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: SELECT al.c04 AS first_leg_airline, COUNT(*) AS interline_shipments FROM tg6t AS l1 JOIN tg6t AS l2 ON l2.c02 = l1.c02 AND l2.c04 = 2 JOIN tx7n AS f1 ON f1.c01 = l1.c03 JOIN tu5q AS a1 ON a1.c01 = f1.c04 JOIN tx7n AS f2 ON f2.c01 = l2.c03 JOIN tu5q AS a2 ON a2.c01 = f2.c04 JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = a1.c05 WHERE l1.c04 = 1 AND a1.c05 <> a2.c05 GROUP BY al.c01, al.c04 ORDER BY interline_shipments DESC, first_leg_airline

question: Self-join tg6t on c02 (leg 1 and leg 2), map each leg to its airline via tx7n and tu5q; count shipments where the airlines differ, per leg-1 c04; most first.

answer_spec: Columns: airline name of leg 1, number of two-leg shipments whose leg 2 is flown by a different airline (interline); ordered by count DESC, name.
gold_sql: SELECT al.c04 AS first_leg_airline, COUNT(*) AS interline_shipments FROM tg6t AS l1 JOIN tg6t AS l2 ON l2.c02 = l1.c02 AND l2.c04 = 2 JOIN tx7n AS f1 ON f1.c01 = l1.c03 JOIN tu5q AS a1 ON a1.c01 = f1.c04 JOIN tx7n AS f2 ON f2.c01 = l2.c03 JOIN tu5q AS a2 ON a2.c01 = f2.c04 JOIN twxv AS al ON al.c01 = a1.c05 WHERE l1.c04 = 1 AND a1.c05 <> a2.c05 GROUP BY al.c01, al.c04 ORDER BY interline_shipments DESC, first_leg_airline
